title: vaccinium molle var. mollissimum
intro: Vaccinium molle var. mollissimum, commonly known as the soft-leaved blueberry, is a plant species within the heath family (Ericaceae). This plant is known for its edible berries, which have been utilized in traditional medicine due to their potential health benefits. The berries of Vaccinium molle var. mollissimum have been reported to possess antioxidant properties and anti-inflammatory effects, which may contribute to their therapeutic actions in reducing oxidative stress and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its potential medicinal properties.
